s02em.run:
Night, under a wet concrete motorway flyover in London: rain-dark pillars, orange sodium light, puddles on the tarmac, a parked van far behind. The man in the attached reference stands very close to a wide-angle lens, shot from slightly below and framed off-centre, his head and hunched shoulders filling the right two-thirds of the frame. He leans hard into the lens mid-line, chin driven forward, head cocked a little to one side, his mask square to the camera so the red triangle shows. One gloved hand jabs a pointing finger straight at the lens, low in the frame and blurred with speed; the other fist is clenched against his chest. Feet planted wide. Gritty music-video photograph, 16:9, no words or signs anywhere.
Thanks.

s02fc.run:
The man in the attached reference, at night under a wet concrete motorway flyover in London, rain dripping from the deck, puddles and sodium orange light on the pillars. A very close chest-up shot from a wide lens held just below his eye line, him slightly left of centre with his left shoulder turned towards camera. He leans his chest in towards the lens, head tilted to one side and chin dipped, mask still facing us with the red triangle clear. Caught mid-move: one gloved hand reaches low towards the lens, fingers loose and spread, palm up, slightly motion-blurred. The other arm hangs loose by his hip. Shoulders dropped, relaxed, weight sunk, feet planted. 16:9 photograph.
Thanks.

s02mm.run:
The man in the attached reference, at night under a wet concrete motorway flyover in London, sodium streetlight on the rain-dark pillars behind him. The camera sits very low, below his chest, with a wide fisheye lens looking up at him; the flyover underside curves across the top of the frame. He leans down over the lens from the hips, feet planted, knees bent, head pushed forward and slightly left of centre, mask facing the lens, the red triangle clearly visible. His right gloved hand is thrust straight at the camera, fingers splayed wide, palm out, motion-blurred and huge in the foreground; his other arm hangs low and loose. Gloves on, no skin. No readable words.
Thanks.

s02kl.run:
At night under a wet concrete motorway flyover in London, the man in the attached reference is caught mid-lunge toward a very close wide-angle lens set low at his waist, looking up at him. He stands off-centre on the left of the frame, body turned three-quarters, one shoulder leading, weight on his front foot and torso pitched forward from the hips. One gloved arm thrusts straight at the lens, palm open and fingers spread wide, huge and motion-blurred in the foreground, low on the left. His other gloved hand is clawed near his collarbone. Head cocked to one side, chin tucked, mask turned to the lens so the red triangle shows. One hard sodium light overhead, puddles, rain dripping off the concrete edge, dark space on the right.
Thanks.

t06ab.run:
The man in the attached reference, on a bright private tropical beach with palm trees and pale sand behind him, photographed handheld from slightly below chest height with a wide lens. He stands a little left of centre, feet planted wide in the sand, heavy and settled, leaning back from the hips with his belly forward. One gloved arm is flung straight up above his head, index finger pointing at the sky, the hand slightly motion-blurred. The other hand holds a champagne flute at his chest, the wine sloshing over the rim. His head is tipped back and turned a touch, the face still towards the lens, mid-laugh. Hard midday sun, real ordinary beach.
Thanks.

t06rz.run:
Low, close, wide-angle shot from waist height, tilted slightly off level, on a bright private tropical beach with palms, pale sand and sea behind. The man in the attached reference is caught mid-lunge towards the lens, off-centre on the left of frame: feet planted wide in the sand, knees bent, his whole upper body pitched diagonally forward, one shoulder dropped low. One arm is flung out wide at hip height, gloved palm open and blurred with motion; the other swings low across his body. His head is cocked to one side but his masked face points into the lens, so close that the wide lens bends him slightly. Harsh tropical sunlight, a real ordinary beach, nothing written anywhere.
Thanks.

t06gf.run:
The man in the attached reference, rapping on a private tropical beach on a bright sunny day, palms and pale sand behind him, turquoise sea on one side. Low wide-angle lens close to him, chest-up, framed off-centre in the left third, the edges of the frame bending slightly. He is hunched forward from the hips, shoulders up and rounded, leaning into the lens, head cocked a little to one side but facing the camera. Both gloved hands are low at belly height, palms down, fingers splayed, caught mid-sweep across his body, with motion blur on the hands. Knees soft, feet planted in the sand. Candid music-video still, harsh midday sun, hard shadows.
Thanks.

t06rr.run:
A rap music video frame on a bright day on a private tropical beach, palms bending over white sand and a turquoise sea. A low-angle, close, wide-lens shot with a slight fisheye bulge, looking up at the man in the attached reference, who stands just left of centre with his feet planted in the sand. He is leaning his chest heavily towards the lens, chin lifted, head tipped slightly back so he looks down his nose at the camera, the red triangle on his mask facing us. Both gloved hands are mid-move: the right is raised to shoulder height, palm turned up and open, slightly motion-blurred; the left pats the air at belly height. Harsh sun, hard shadows, open sky behind his head. No words anywhere.
Thanks.
